# gitshot

> Upload images to GitHub issues, PRs, and discussions from the terminal.

gitshot is a CLI tool that solves a fundamental gap in GitHub's ecosystem: there is no API for uploading images to issues or pull requests. The official GitHub CLI (gh) does not support this and has closed the feature request (cli/cli#1895, open since 2020).

## Installation

```
npx gitshot image.png
npm install -g gitshot
```

Requires Node.js 22+. Zero runtime dependencies.

## Usage

Upload an image (auto-detects best backend):
```
gitshot rick.gif
```

Upload and comment on a PR:
```
gitshot rick.gif | gh pr comment 42 --body-file -
```

Upload and create an issue with image:
```
gitshot bug.png | gh issue create --title "Bug" --body-file -
```

Multiple images:
```
gitshot before.png after.png
```

Raw URL only:
```
gitshot --raw rick.gif
```

JSON output (for AI agents):
```
gitshot --json rick.gif
```

## Backends

- release: GitHub Releases (default). Uploads to <user>/gitshot-images repo as release assets. Permanent, CDN-backed URLs. Auto-creates repo on first use. Requires gh CLI authenticated.
- catbox: Catbox.moe (fallback). Zero config, no signup, 200MB limit. Always works.
- cloudinary: Cloudinary CDN. Set CLOUDINARY_URL env var. 25GB free tier.
- imgbb: imgbb hosting. Set IMGBB_API_KEY env var. 32MB limit.

Auto-detection order: --backend flag > CLOUDINARY_URL > IMGBB_API_KEY > gh CLI > catbox

## Flags

-b, --backend <name>    release | catbox | cloudinary | imgbb
-r, --raw               Output raw URL only
    --json              Output JSON
    --repo <owner/repo> Target repo for release backend
    --tag <name>        Release tag (default: _gitshot)
-v, --version           Print version
-h, --help              Show help

## Environment Variables

CLOUDINARY_URL    cloudinary://API_KEY:API_SECRET@CLOUD_NAME
IMGBB_API_KEY     API key from https://api.imgbb.com
GITHUB_TOKEN      GitHub token (alternative to gh auth)

## Agent Integration

gitshot is designed for AI agent workflows:
- stdout contains only URLs/markdown (pipe-safe)
- stderr contains status logs
- --json mode for structured output
- No interactive prompts
- Exit code 0 = success, 1 = failure

Install as a skill: npx skills add vipulgupta2048/gitshot
